description: Extract Subtitles — Extract the first embedded text subtitle track from an MKV, MP4, WebM or AVI video up to 500 MB. Save an SRT file; burned-in captions are not extracted.. Video And Audio Studio run — processes in the browser but uses more credits per run than the Document / Image / Scanner workspaces. Welcome credits cover a limited number of runs. Day Pass does not include this workspace. All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
name: mio_video_extract_subtitles
